subject: Ziggy's go: include the stencil-and-composite route as one bounded try for James's lettering pass, beside the Gemini edit, after Grok's extra round is looked at
body: Ziggy, in the session at about 06:05 UTC, in substance: the stencil-and-composite route is interesting to explore and he wants to see whether it is viable, even if tenuous; he would like to know; go ahead and include that one. So the lettering-pass options for James, once Grok's extra round has returned and Ziggy has looked at it, are: a Gemini (AI Studio) or Flow edit of the v004 clean reference per ink rev 3 (95c42de4…), and one bounded stencil-and-composite try in Comfy using Grok's black-on-white stencil sheets already on D: (handoffs/james_gun_removal_20261014/received/stencil_set_v003/, regenerated as lettering per rev 3 if Grok's extra round delivers legible stencils) laid onto the clean reference. Mode, cost, intake and the order of the tries are yours; the writer requests no run. DECISIONS item 60 carries his go. The James look stays unlocked until a route renders the writing and Ziggy accepts it.
source: Ziggy in Claude's session, 2026-10-14 about 06:05 UTC.
